notes.title: v1.05 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that caused the full-screen mode to fail when using the CJK input method
2. Optimized Japanese/Korean translations
3. Fixed a resolution issue on the Steamdeck platform

notes.title: Update instructions for July 21:
notes.content:
Adjusted the difficulty of the "OVERLIMIT" level in L9
Reduced the interval between stone launches by the Gargoyle
Corrected several errors in achievement descriptions

notes.title: 7.20 Update Notes:
notes.content:
1,Fixed a bug that prevented the "Crazy green fly!" achievement from being unlocked.
2,Fixed a bug where the final BOSS could still damage players after its death.

notes.title: Update Description on 7.19
notes.content: After respawning at a checkpoint, all traps and enemy behaviors are no longer random or inherited from the state before death, but are now deterministic.
